context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 216ai Sprint A Item 6 verified: (1) Horizontal tab bar no longer shows separate 'Studio builder', 'Timetable', or 'Classes' pills - replaced with single 'Classes & Timetable' pill (data-testid mbr-tab-schedule).
